    return s

def _is_sidon(row):
    """Check if a row is a Sidon set (all pairwise differences distinct)."""
    n = len(row)
    diffs = []
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            diffs.append(row[j] - row[i])
    return len(diffs) == len(set(diffs))
